## Out of scope (please check before filing)

This project is intentionally narrow. The following are explicit non-goals
for v0.x:

- [ ] **Linux / Windows support** — macOS-only by design. Deferred.
- [ ] **Programmatic API** (`import { transcribe } from ...`) — CLI-only
      surface. Deferred.
- [ ] **Prebuilt binary distribution** — every binary is source-built on
      the user's machine for trust/reproducibility. Deferred.
- [ ] **Telemetry / phone-home metrics** — conflicts with the offline
      design driver.

If your request falls into one of these, please open a discussion rather
than a feature request.
